reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount and routes the four inline midpoint copies (schedule app x2, forecast, preview, template) through it.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the midpoint formula and leaves one definition; no new copies are introduced.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already owns schedule amount helpers, and server callers import it.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its callers, unit tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A single named function decides missing/single/ranged amounts; the only leftover is schedule-template's own op==='isbetween' ternary around the call, which is harmless.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule and budget/schedule-template createScheduleList
